webhooks.detail: Jira Cloud webhooks over HTTPS; many events (jira:issue_created, sprint_started, etc.)

evidence.quote: You can use Jira webhooks to notify your app or web application when certain events occur in Jira.

sandbox.detail: Free Atlassian Cloud developer instance (Jira Software 5 users, Confluence 5, JSM 1 agent) for dev/testing only

evidence.quote: we'll give you a free developer instance

rate_limits.summary: Points-based quota model plus per-second burst limit per endpoint (defaults ~100 rps GET/POST, 50 PUT/DELETE); 429 on excess

evidence.quote: When any limit is exceeded, Jira returns an HTTP `429 Too Many Requests` response.
Forge can be used to build custom apps and integrations or apps distributed through the Atlassian Marketplace.
